commands.sql: INSERT INTO t(c,p,n) VALUES(NULL,'new',2) RETURNING c || 'x',coalesce(p,c)
UPDATE t SET p=NULL WHERE n=1 RETURNING CASE WHEN n=1 THEN c ELSE p END,coalesce(old.c,new.c)
DELETE FROM t WHERE n=1 RETURNING upper(old.c),coalesce(new.p,'x')
MERGE INTO t USING (VALUES (1,'updated')) s(n,v) ON t.n=s.n WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET p=s.v RETURNING coalesce(old.c,new.c),coalesce(old.p,new.c)

queries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE t SET p=NULL RETURNING old.c AS c,new.p AS p) SELECT coalesce(p,'x'),upper(c) FROM changed
WITH removed AS (DELETE FROM t RETURNING new.c AS c,old.p AS p) SELECT coalesce(c,p),lower(p) FROM removed
